AI Tools Hub

Discover, compare, and access the right AI tools for every task.

One place for the AI tools that matter to teaching, research, and student work. Every entry records what the tool is genuinely good at, which plans exist, whether a free tier covers the job, and the cheapest legitimate route to access — including student verification, educational licences, and open-source substitutes.

How this catalogue is kept honest

Prices and offers move constantly. Entries record only publicly published plans, and anything we have not re-checked recently is flagged on the card rather than quietly presented as current.

Nothing here is an endorsement or a procurement decision. Confirm terms on the provider’s own site before you or your department pays for anything.

About the platform

AI Tools Hub is a catalogue maintained by the Prototyping Research Center at the University of East Capital. It exists because the same questions kept arriving from students, teaching staff, and research groups: which tool fits this task, does the free tier cover it, and is there an academic route that avoids the subscription altogether.

The catalogue is deliberately editorial. Tools are included because they earn a place in academic work, described in plain terms, and listed with their limitations alongside their strengths. There is no affiliate relationship with any provider listed here, and inclusion is not an institutional endorsement or a procurement recommendation.

Corrections, additions, and pricing updates are welcome — the catalogue is only as good as its last review.

How an entry is built

  1. Publicly published plans onlyPricing comes from the provider’s own pricing page or documentation, never from estimates.
  2. Regional and conditional terms flaggedStudent offers and regional pricing are marked as conditional rather than presented as universal.
  3. Cheapest legitimate route identifiedFree tiers, educational programmes, and open-source substitutes are preferred over paid plans wherever they do the job.
  4. Unverified figures markedAnything not re-checked in the current cycle carries a verification flag on the card and in the detail view.
